journal.text: Initial deployment: $47.5k across seven rising, liquid names; keep $2.5k cash for gaps/opportunities. At June 30 close NVDA 157.99 vs May 29 139.19; MSFT 497.41 vs 458.68; AVGO 275.65 vs 241.97; META 738.09 vs 645.05; DASH 246.51 vs 204.58; STX 144.33 vs 118.14; ALNY 326.09 vs 292.90. Diversify semis/AI, software, internet, storage, biotech, though growth-factor correlation remains significant. Review trend and relative strength daily; trim/replace on sustained reversal or if concentration grows, and invest later monthly deposits in strongest confirmed trends rather than automatically averaging down.

Hold existing seven positions and $2,500 cash. July 1 broad growth pullback: NVDA 153.30 (-3.0%), AVGO 264.74 (-4.0%), META 719.22 (-2.6%), DASH 238.01 (-3.4%), but each still above late-June breakout area; MSFT 492.05 remains near highs, STX rose to 145.04. One weak session does not negate June uptrends; avoid reactive churn or spending reserve into correlated weakness. Reconsider if declines persist below June 23-24 levels or if relative strength rotates decisively; reassess new cash at next deposit.

Hold seven positions and $2,500 cash. July 2 NVDA and AVGO rebounded to 157.25 and 269.90; STX broke higher to 151.94 on elevated volume, ALNY reached 329.77. META 713.57 and DASH 238.80 remain below June 30 highs but above June 24 closes (712.20 and 236.17); no confirmed breakdown. Avoid chasing STX's sharp one-day rise or rotating on two soft sessions. Reconsider META/DASH on sustained breaks below June 23-24 support, and reassess portfolio strength or deploy cash at next monthly deposit.

Hold seven positions and $2,500 cash. Through July 3 NVDA 159.34 and MSFT 498.84 made/approached June highs; AVGO 275.18 recovered June 30 level, ALNY 331.91 reached a new short-term high. STX 149.44 eased after its July 2 surge but remains above June 30's 144.33. META 719.01 and DASH 238.79 are below June 30 peaks yet above June 24 closes of 712.20 and 236.17. Trends remain intact; no reason to churn or force small reserve into correlated growth exposure. Reconsider on sustained breaks of those support areas or broader relative-strength deterioration; allocate incoming monthly cash after reviewing trends.

Hold seven positions and $2,500 reserve. July 7 DASH rebounded to 246.89 near its June 30 high, while NVDA 158.24, MSFT 497.72 and AVGO 274.18 stayed near recent highs. META held above 712 support; STX eased to 148.39 but remains above its 144.33 June 30 close. ALNY fell from 331.91 to 324.13, still above its late-June range; monitor for further selling. No confirmed trend break warrants rotation or adding more correlated exposure. Reconsider if META closes below 712, DASH below 236, STX below 144, or ALNY persistently below 315; review fresh opportunities when monthly cash arrives.

Hold seven positions and $2,500 cash. Through July 8 NVDA closed at a new 35-session high of 160; MSFT 496.62 and AVGO 271.80 remain near late-June highs. META 720.67 and DASH 241.47 retain June support. STX 144.47 has pulled back to its June 30 breakout level (144.33), while ALNY 317.50 is nearing its 315 support after two declines. Neither has confirmed a breakdown; avoid trading on one weak session. Reconsider STX on a close below 144, ALNY on a sustained break below 315, META below 712 or DASH below 236; reassess if weakness spreads to larger holdings.

Exit STX: July 9 close 142.01 fell below the monitored 144 breakout level, near its 141.71 session low on 6.20m shares, after declining from 151.94 on July 2. Other six holdings remain above monitored support; NVDA 162.88, MSFT 503.51 and AVGO 277.90 reached fresh short-term highs, META 732.78 and DASH 246.06 rebounded, ALNY 320.87 held above 315. Retain the other holdings and cash from the sale pending a clearer setup. Reconsider STX after a sustained recovery above 145; review ALNY if below 315, META below 712, DASH below 236, or broader trend deterioration.

Hold six positions and $7,529.94 cash. Through July 10 NVDA advanced to 164.10, but MSFT 501.48 and AVGO 275.40 eased from July 9 highs. DASH fell to 238.24, near monitored 236 support; META retreated to 727.24 but remains above 712; ALNY stabilized at 322.64 above 315. Broad growth candidates also showed mixed action, so avoid redeploying STX-sale proceeds without a clearer entry. Reconsider DASH on a close below 236, ALNY persistently below 315, META below 712, or if broader leadership weakens; consider new purchases on a confirmed breakout or constructive pullback.

Add $3,500 AMZN: July 11 close 225.02 broke above its late-June 223.82 and July 7–9 224.29 highs, with 50.52m shares; diversify existing six holdings while retaining roughly $4,030 cash. NVDA and MSFT remain strong; DASH recovered to 240.44, META 717.51 is above 712. ALNY closed 314.94, marginally below monitored 315 for the first time: keep the small holding for now, but reconsider if it remains below 315 or falls decisively. Reassess AMZN if it loses 219–220, DASH below 236, META below 712, or market leadership deteriorates.

Buy $2,500 PLTR after its July 14 close at 149.15 cleared the June 26 148.21 high, with 81.77m shares traded versus 52.13m on July 11; retain roughly $1,530 cash and cap this volatile new holding near 5% of equity. ALNY recovered to 315.75 after one close below 315, so hold rather than sell on a marginal break. Existing NVDA/MSFT remain near recent highs, while META, DASH, AVGO and AMZN hold their previously monitored levels. Reconsider PLTR on a close back below 143–144 (especially 140), ALNY if it remains below 315, DASH below 236, META below 712, AMZN below 219–220, or broader growth weakness.

Exit ALNY: July 15 closed 311.12, its second close below the monitored 315 level in three sessions, with a lower low of 309.57. Rotate $3,800 into AMD after its 155.61 close cleared the late-June 147.75 high on 93.37m shares; keep approximately $1,500 cash, subject to opening fills. NVDA, MSFT, AVGO and AMZN remain strong. META closed 710.39, only marginally below 712, and DASH 236.77 is narrowly above 236: monitor rather than liquidate on one marginal breach. Reconsider AMD on a close below 147–148, META if it remains below 712, DASH below 236, PLTR below 143–144, or broad semiconductor weakness.

Exit META: July 16 close 702.91 is its second close below monitored 712, with declining lows from 737.53 on July 9. Exit DASH: 234.50 fell below monitored 236 after 236.77 the prior day, extending lower highs since June 30. Rotate $6,000 to GOOG, near its recent 185.41 high with a rising July trend, and $4,000 to SHOP, whose 120.00 close cleared its recent 118.65 high on 12.71m shares. Retain roughly $4,000 cash subject to opening fills; semiconductors already form a large exposure. Keep NVDA/MSFT/AVGO/AMD/AMZN/PLTR. Reassess GOOG below 176-178, SHOP below 112-115, AMD below 147-148, or if broad leadership falters.

Hold eight positions and $3,997.65 cash. July 17 closes show NVDA 173, MSFT 511.70 and AVGO 286.45 at recent highs; SHOP followed its breakout with a strong 126.75 close on 13.38m shares, while GOOG reached 184.70. Avoid adding immediately after yesterday's rotation or chasing SHOP's two-day surge. Reconsider SHOP below 120, then 115; GOOG below 176–178; AMD below 147–148; AMZN below 219–220; and reduce exposure if multiple leaders break recent supports. Deploy cash on a better entry or a fresh confirmed breakout.

Hold all eight positions and $3,997.65 cash. July 18 closes: NVDA 172.41, MSFT 510.05 and AVGO 283.34 softened modestly after recent highs; AMD 156.99 pulled back from 160.41 but remains above its 147–148 breakout level. GOOG 185.94 made a new recent closing high, SHOP 127.07 held most of its high-volume breakout, and AMZN 226.13 recovered. No monitored support broke; avoid adding to concentrated technology exposure on a mixed session. Reconsider SHOP below 120 (especially 115), GOOG below 176–178, AMD below 147–148, AMZN below 219–220, or broader simultaneous leader breakdowns; deploy cash on a better entry or sustained breakout.

Buy $2,500 AMZN: July 21 closed at 229.30, above its July 15 high of 227.27, with volume of 40.3m; add to the smaller position rather than concentrate further in semiconductors or chase GOOG's 191.15 breakout. Retain roughly $1,498 cash and the other seven holdings. Reconsider AMZN if it closes below 219–220, SHOP below 120, GOOG below 176–178, AMD below 147–148, or multiple leaders lose support.

Hold eight positions and $1,497.65 cash. July 22 brought a broad technology pullback: NVDA 167.03, AVGO 278.59, AMD 154.72 and SHOP 123.71, while GOOG advanced to 192.11. Despite the weakness, AMZN 227.47, AMD and SHOP remain above monitored support; avoid reacting to one down session or adding to already concentrated exposure. Reconsider if AMZN closes below 219–220, SHOP below 120, AMD below 147–148, GOOG below 176–178, or several leaders break support together; consider deploying cash after stabilization.

Hold all eight positions and $1,497.65 cash. July 23 reversed much of the prior day's weakness: NVDA 170.78, AVGO 283.69, AMD 158.65 and PLTR 154.63; GOOG 191.51 and AMZN 228.29 remain near recent highs. SHOP dipped intraday to 118.87 but recovered to close 122.21, still above the monitored 120 closing threshold; watch for a decisive break rather than sell on the intraday move. Portfolio remains heavily exposed to technology, so avoid adding with limited cash. Reconsider if SHOP closes below 120 (especially 115), AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 147–148, GOOG below 176–178, or multiple large positions break down together.

Hold eight positions and $1,497.65 cash. July 24 closes strengthened across the larger holdings: NVDA 173.74, AVGO 288.71, AMD 162.12, MSFT 510.88 and AMZN 232.23 (new recent closing high); GOOG 193.20 retained most of its opening gap despite an intraday reversal. SHOP 122.08 remains above the 120 closing threshold, though below its recent 128.43 high. With nearly all capital deployed and concentrated in technology, avoid chasing; reconsider if SHOP closes below 120 (especially 115), AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 147–148, GOOG below 176–178, or multiple leaders weaken together.

Hold eight positions and $1,497.65 cash. July 25 closes show continued strength: AMD 166.47, PLTR 158.80, MSFT 513.71, AVGO 290.18 and GOOG 194.08; NVDA 173.50 and AMZN 231.44 remain near highs. SHOP recovered to 124.43, above the monitored 120 level. With 97% of account already invested and technology exposure concentrated, avoid adding on strength. Reconsider if SHOP closes below 120 (especially 115), AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 147–148, GOOG below 176–178, or multiple leaders weaken together; reassess allocations when new cash arrives.

Hold eight positions and $1,497.65 cash. July 28 closes: NVDA 176.75 and AVGO 294.30 reached fresh 30-session highs; AMD accelerated to 173.66 on higher volume. AMZN 232.79, GOOG 193.42 and MSFT 512.50 remain near highs; SHOP rebounded to 126.84, above the monitored 120 level. With 97% invested and technology concentrated, avoid adding after the run. Reconsider if SHOP closes below 120, AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 155 then 147–148, GOOG below 176–178, or several leaders weaken together; review allocation when the next deposit arrives.

Hold eight positions and $1,497.65 cash ahead of the next monthly deposit. July 29 closes: AVGO 297.42, AMD 177.44 on unusually high volume, and GOOG 196.43 made recent highs; NVDA 175.51, MSFT 512.57 and AMZN 231.01 remain near highs. PLTR 156.24 and SHOP 124.85 eased but remain above monitored levels. Already ~97% invested, heavily in technology; avoid adding after a sharp run. Reconsider if SHOP closes below 120, AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 155, GOOG below 176–178, or several leaders deteriorate together; review diversification and purchases on the next deposit.

Hold eight positions and $1,497.65 cash pending the next monthly deposit. July 30 closes: NVDA 179.27, AVGO 302.62, AMD 179.51 and GOOG 197.44 extended strength; MSFT 513.24, AMZN 230.19 and PLTR 158.61 remain firm. SHOP slipped to 123.01 but remains above the monitored 120 level. At ~97% invested and concentrated in technology, avoid chasing with the small residual cash. Reassess allocations with new cash; reconsider sooner if SHOP closes below 120, AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 155, GOOG below 176–178, or several leaders weaken together.

Deploy $37,000 of the $50,000 August deposit in dollar-sized orders, keeping about $14,498 cash (~14% of account) given July 31 broad semiconductor weakness and unknown opening gaps. Add to MSFT (513.24 to 533.50 on high volume), GOOG and NVDA for sustained trends; start a modest META position after its high-volume breakout to 773.44, without overcommitting after an 11% jump. Diversify existing tech-heavy holdings into AEP (113.14), XEL (73.44) and WMT (97.98), which showed steadier July trends; add smaller CEG, CDNS and DASH positions for relative strength. Do not add to AMZN ahead of uncertain post-close reaction, nor AVGO/AMD after July 31 reversals. Reconsider if tech weakness persists across multiple sessions or if SHOP closes below 120, AMZN below 219–220, AMD below 155, GOOG below 176–178; review new purchases and cash after observing actual fills.

Reduce risk after Aug 1 broad technology weakness. AMZN fell from 234.11 to 214.75 on 122m shares, breaking the previously monitored 219–220 level; SHOP closed 118.60 below the monitored 120 with rising volume. Exit both, selling before buys to fund orders regardless of opening gaps. Shift $7k toward WMT (98.49) and AEP (113.58), whose recent trends held up better, and retain cash plus the remaining growth holdings; avoid aggressively buying the dip after two weak sessions in semiconductors. Reconsider exits if AMZN recovers above 220 and SHOP above 120 with sustained strength; reduce additional tech exposure if NVDA breaks 167, AMD 155, or GOOG 176–178, or revisit purchases if market leadership stabilizes.

Hold existing positions and $17,251 cash (~17% of account). Aug 4 brought a broad rebound: NVDA 180, MSFT 535.64, GOOG 195.75, AMD 176.78 and META 776.37 recovered from Aug 1 weakness, while WMT 99.59, AEP 115 and XEL 74.24 held their upward trends. AMZN continued lower to 211.65; SHOP reclaimed 120 at 125.21, but one session is not enough to confirm sustained recovery after its breakdown. Avoid chasing the rebound or adding to an already technology-heavy portfolio after one strong day. Reconsider deploying cash if leadership holds through another session; reassess risk if NVDA closes below 167, AMD below 155, GOOG below 176–178, or the recent weakness broadens.

Hold positions and $17,251 cash (~17%). Aug 5 reversed much of Aug 4's broad rebound: MSFT 527.75, AVGO 292.93, AMD 174.31 and META 763.46 fell; even AEP, WMT and CEG eased. NVDA 178.26 and GOOG 195.32 remain above the monitored downside levels, while PLTR surged to 173.27 on heavy volume. SHOP's second recovery close at 127 is encouraging, but technology breadth remains weak and AMZN at 213.75 remains below its 219–220 recovery threshold. Wait for stronger follow-through before spending cash or reentering prior exits. Reconsider if NVDA closes below 167, AMD below 155, GOOG below 176–178, or if weakness spreads; deploy cash selectively if leadership stabilizes across multiple sessions.

Rotate out of AMD after its Aug 6 drop to 163.12 on 134m shares, below its Aug 1 close and with an intraday test of 157.80; a much weaker reaction than NVDA or AVGO. Reenter AMZN modestly at $3k after it reclaimed the previously monitored 219–220 level, closing 222.31 near its daily high. Keep roughly $18k cash because this is only one recovery close and technology remains uneven. SHOP jumped 22% to 154.90 on heavy volume, but avoid buying immediately after that gap. Reassess AMZN if it falls back below 219–220; reconsider AMD if it recovers above 172–175 with sustained strength, and cut broader technology risk if NVDA breaks 167 or GOOG 176–178.

Add $3,500 to WMT: its Aug 6 breakout from ~99 to 103.36 on elevated volume held at 103.12 on Aug 7, offering non-technology strength while MSFT and CDNS softened. Retain about $14,900 cash rather than chase APP's 12% jump or AMD's single-day rebound to 172.40 after the sharp prior decline. Hold existing positions. Reassess WMT if it closes back below 99–100, AMZN if below 219–220, and broad technology exposure if NVDA breaks 167 or GOOG 176–178; deploy remaining cash if recovery broadens and persists.

Add $3,500 GOOG after its Aug 8 close of 202.09 broke above the late-July 198.48 high on 24.4m shares, versus roughly 15m on Aug 6–7. NVDA and AVGO also held recent gains, while WMT retained its breakout; keep approximately $11.4k cash because MSFT and CDNS remain soft and technology already dominates holdings. Avoid chasing AAPL's three-day 13% jump or APP's sharp rally. Reconsider GOOG if it loses 195–198, WMT below 99–100, AMZN below 219–220, and overall technology risk if NVDA falls below 167; deploy cash if strength broadens sustainably.

Rotate out of CDNS: five successive lower closes to 349.09 after its 371.03 July 30 peak, while other holdings already provide substantial technology exposure. Buy $4,000 GILD for healthcare diversification: its Aug 8 breakout from 110.28 to 119.41 came on 13.1m shares and Aug 11 held the gain at 120.47. Maintain roughly $9.8k cash and other holdings; reconsider GILD below 114–115, GOOG below 195–198, WMT below 99–100, AMZN below 219–220, or overall technology exposure if NVDA closes below 167. Avoid chasing MU/APP after their rapid gains.

Rotate out of both utilities: AEP has slipped from its Aug 4 close of 115 to 111.99, below its July 30 breakout close of 113.25; XEL fell from 74.24 to 72.39 over the same interval. Buy $8k COST for non-tech strength: Aug 12 close 991.25 is a new 20-session high, following a steady climb from 927.51 on July 30. Add $3k GILD: the Aug 8 high-volume breakout remains intact near 120, diversifying away from technology. Retain roughly $10.6k cash. Reassess COST if it closes below 968–970, GILD below 114–115, GOOG below 195–198, WMT below 99–100, or NVDA below 167; avoid chasing the rapid gains in APP and MU.

Exit CEG: Aug 13 close 327.63 is down 7.7% from Aug 4 and below its July 30 breakout close of 345.27. Exit small DASH position: its post-Aug 7 surge to 270.99 has faded to 254.20, with a 250.21 intraday low on Aug 13. Allocate $4k to ROST for non-tech momentum: it closed at a 15-session high of 150.28 after rising from 137.01 on Aug 1, with no comparable one-day gap. Keep roughly $12k cash; avoid adding to technology on yesterday's reversals. Reassess ROST below 144–145, WMT below 99–100, COST below 968–970, GILD below 114–115, GOOG below 195–198, and broader tech risk if NVDA closes below 167.

Hold. Aug 14 closes keep the existing positions above their reassessment levels: ROST 147.38 (>144–145), COST 975.39 (>968–970), WMT 100.85 (>99–100), GILD 119.02 (>114–115), GOOG 203.82 (>195–198), and NVDA 182.02 (>167). AMZN recovered to 230.98 on stronger volume, but technology already dominates the portfolio; the recent pullbacks in retail argue against committing the $12.1k cash buffer today. Reconsider if these support levels fail on a close or if sustained strength offers a better entry.

Exit small PLTR position: Aug 15 close 177.17 is down 5.2% from Aug 12 and below 180, with four consecutive declines after its earnings-driven surge. Buy $5k PEP for non-tech diversification: 150.40 is a 22-session closing high, rising from 137.92 on Jul 31, with stronger volume Friday. Retain roughly $10k cash while WMT (100) and COST (972.04) approach prior reassessment levels. Reconsider PEP on a close below 145; reassess WMT below 99–100, COST below 968–970, GILD below 114–115, GOOG below 195–198, and NVDA below 167.

Hold positions and ~$10k cash. Aug 18 closes remain above prior exit levels: ROST 146.06 (>144–145), COST 979.35 (>968–970), WMT 100.70 (>99–100), GILD 117.99 (>114–115), GOOG 204.29 (>195–198), NVDA 182.01 (>167), PEP 149.55 (>145). ROST's declining closes on rising volume and MSFT's slide to 517.10 warrant caution, not an additional buy into an already tech-heavy portfolio. Reassess ROST if it closes below 144–145, MSFT below ~510–513, or the other named levels fail; deploy cash if strength resumes with a better entry.

Trim MSFT by 13 shares: Aug 19 close 509.77 fell below the previously flagged 510–513 reassessment zone after sliding from 529.24 on Aug 12. Broad tech weakness (NVDA 175.64, AVGO 294.91, META 751.48) argues against redeploying proceeds today. Keep remaining holdings and raise cash buffer to roughly $16.6k. Reconsider remaining MSFT if it closes below ~500–505 or rebuilds above 520; revisit NVDA below 167, GOOG below 195–198, ROST below 144–145 and COST below 968–970.

Buy $3.5k FAST to diversify away from weakening mega-cap tech. FAST closed Aug 20 at 49.54, up from 45.44 on Aug 5 and near its recent 49.90 high, while MSFT fell to 505.72 and AVGO to 291.17. Keep approximately $13.1k cash and other holdings; COST (994.57) and WMT (102.57) strengthened. Reconsider FAST on a close below 47–48, MSFT below 500–505, NVDA below 167, GOOG below 195–198, ROST below 144–145, or COST below 968–970.

Exit WMT and the remaining MSFT. WMT fell from 102.57 to 97.96 on 51.8m shares, breaking the previously flagged 99–100 zone; MSFT closed 504.24, inside the previously flagged 500–505 reassessment zone after a sustained slide. Retain other holdings and cash rather than buy into broad weakness. COST fell to 969.68, near its 968–970 threshold: reconsider if it closes below 968; revisit ROST below 144–145, GILD below 114–115, GOOG below 195–198, NVDA below 167, and FAST below 47–48. Reassess redeployment if prices stabilize.

Exit COST and GILD after their previously flagged support zones broke: COST closed 958.54 below 968 on elevated volume, and GILD closed 114.77 near its 114.52 intraday low after falling from 120.14 on Aug 13. Add $4k FAST, which closed at a recent high of 50.39, and initiate a smaller $3k INSM position on its sustained rise from 111.24 on Aug 4 to 131.88. Retain a substantial cash buffer rather than chase Friday's broad tech rebound. Reconsider FAST below 47–48, INSM below 125–127, and the existing tech positions if weakness resumes; reconsider COST/GILD after stabilization above 970/118 respectively.

Deploy $10k of the $38.7k cash reserve into strength while retaining roughly $28.7k cash. STX closed 164, above its prior August high near 160.6; LITE closed 123.42, above its recent 120–121 range; GOOG closed 209.16, recovering from 200.19 on Aug 20 and exceeding its prior 207.33 August high. Keep other positions: FAST remains near highs, while INSM at 128.32 is above the previously flagged 125–127 reassessment zone despite yesterday's pullback. Reconsider STX below 154–157, LITE below 115–117, GOOG below 198–200, INSM below 125, FAST below 47–48, or if broad tech weakness resumes. Avoid further deployment until these breakouts hold.

Hold all positions and $28.7k cash. Yesterday's new STX and LITE positions followed through to 165.24 and 124.62; GOOG eased to 207.95 but remains above its prior August high near 207.33. INSM rebounded to 132.17, FAST holds near 50, and PEP's slide to 147 remains above its 145 exit threshold. Avoid adding immediately after the $10k deployment while broader tech recovery remains uneven. Reconsider STX below 154–157, LITE below 115–117, GOOG below 198–200, INSM below 125, FAST below 47–48, PEP below 145, or a renewed broad decline; deploy cash after sustained strength.

Hold positions and $28.7k cash. STX 167.24, LITE 125.84 and INSM 134.53 continue to make higher closes; GOOG 208.21 remains above its earlier August 207.33 high. PEP recovered to 147.64, above the 145 reassessment level; FAST holds near 50. NVDA traded unusually heavy volume (235.5m shares) but closed nearly unchanged at 181.60, so avoid adding concentrated chip exposure ahead of an unknown opening gap. Do not chase extended STX/LITE; reassess STX below 154–157, LITE below 115–117, GOOG below 198–200, INSM below 125, FAST below 47–48, PEP below 145, and NVDA on a sustained break below 173–175. Deploy reserve selectively if strength persists and broad tech stabilizes.

Deploy $6.5k of $28.7k cash, leaving about $22.2k before unknown opening fills. Initiate a modest APP position: its Aug 28 close of 483.75 cleared the earlier 473.70 August high on elevated volume, offering strength outside the existing semiconductor holdings. Add modestly to INSM as its 134.97 close holds near recent highs after its August advance. Hold other positions: GOOG closed at a new August high of 212.37; STX and LITE surged to 172.38 and 135.55, but avoid chasing their sharp moves. NVDA's 281.8m-share, wide-range session closed at 180.17, warranting caution with additional chip exposure. Reconsider APP if it loses 445–450, INSM below 125, STX below 154–157, LITE below 115–117, GOOG below 198–200, or NVDA persistently below 173–175. Reserve cash for reversals or better-confirmed opportunities.

Deploy $32k of cash across strength and diversify, while trimming $6.5k NVDA after its 174.18 close below the 173–175 watch zone on a second consecutive very-heavy-volume decline. GOOG closed at a fresh August high of 213.53; AAPL has held near its August highs at 232.14. ORLY remains relatively steady near 104, ALNY consolidates its August run around 446.51, and INSM closed at another recent high of 136.10. Add only modestly to volatile APP (478.59, above the prior 473.70 breakout level). Retain approximately $46.7k cash after planned orders, subject to unknown opening fills. Reassess NVDA if it cannot reclaim 180; GOOG below 200–205, AAPL below 224, ORLY below 100, ALNY below 425–430, INSM below 125, and APP below 445–450. Avoid adding to STX/LITE after their Friday reversals.

Exit remaining NVDA: Sep 2 close 170.78 marks a third heavy-volume decline from Aug 28's 180.17 and remains below the 173–175 warning zone. Rotate approximately $7k into two smaller non-chip positions: TTWO closed 240.95 near its July high on increased volume, and ROST recovered to 151.25, above its prior August closing high. Retain roughly $46.5k cash given weak recent chip action and yesterday's sizable deployment. Hold existing GOOG and INSM strength without chasing INSM's 6.8% one-day rise. Reconsider TTWO below 229–232, ROST below 145–147, GOOG below 200–205, INSM below 125–130, and any further chip exposure only after NVDA regains 180.

Deploy $7.5k of $46.5k cash into PANW and add to STX, retaining roughly $39k cash before unknown opening prices. PANW closed 191.53, near its late-August highs around 191–193 despite weakness elsewhere in software; this adds a cybersecurity exposure distinct from our existing holdings. STX closed above its Aug 28 high at 176.32 on 3.79m volume, recovering from Friday's reversal, but size the add modestly because NVDA remains below 175 and chip risk persists. GOOG surged 9% to 231.10 on 72.3m shares; hold the winner rather than chase the gap or increase an already 17%-of-account position. Reconsider PANW on closes below 183–185, STX below 165–168, GOOG below 211–215 following the gap, and INSM below 130–135. Keep cash for confirmation or pullbacks; reconsider PEP if it closes below 145 after its failed Sep 2 upside gap.

Rotate out of PEP after its Sep 2 gap faded from a 157.44 open to a 146.89 Sep 4 close, below its August 15 close and approaching the previously flagged 145 level. Add $5k AMZN: 235.68 closed above its late-August highs on 59.4m volume. Start $4k WMT as its recovery from the Aug 25–28 lows around 96 reached 100.93, replacing some defensive PEP exposure. Add $3k to smaller LITE holding after a 141.91 closing high on 8.46m volume; limit sizing due to volatile chip-related exposure and NVDA remaining below 175. Keep approximately $32k cash after net deployment, with GOOG already a large 17% position. Reconsider AMZN on closes below 226–229, WMT below 96–98, LITE below 130–133, STX below 168–172, and GOOG below 211–215; avoid further semiconductor additions if NVDA stays weak.

Exit FAST after its Sep 5 decline to 47.99 on 9.38m shares erased its late-August advance and brought it near the Aug 7 support at 47.48. Start $5k ADSK: it held the Aug 29 upside gap and closed Sep 5 at 326.37, a new high for the observed period. Start a smaller $3k MU despite weak NVDA: MU rose to 131.37 on 28.4m shares, breaking above its August peak while NVDA closed at 167.02; keep semiconductor exposure limited. GOOG is already about 17% of account; retain other holdings and roughly $31k cash rather than chase AVGO's volatile Sep 5 gap, which faded from 355.78 open to 334.89 close on heavy volume.
